# STUFF'D Bagels

> Cape Town's first stuffed bagel. Fresh, handmade stuffed bagels sold from our cart at markets and festivals across Cape Town. Order on WhatsApp, collect at the venue, pay with card (Yoco) or cash.

Slogan: "Every bite packed right." Cape Town, South Africa. Est. 2026. Street food, pop-up, handmade. No tables, no reservations. More markets, more bagels.

## Menu (ZAR)
- Pizza Bagel: R85 (pepperoni, cheese, cream cheese)
- Jalapeno Bagel: R70 (jalapeno, cheese, cream cheese)
- Cheesy Bagel: R80 (cheese, cream cheese)
- Plain Bagel: R65 (cream cheese)
- Extra topping, cheese or jalapeno: +R5

## How ordering works
- Pick your bagels on the website, then send the ready-made order message on WhatsApp.
- Collect at the venue on your pickup date.
- Pay at the cart with Yoco (card) or cash. No online payment.
- Private events: message on WhatsApp for a custom quote.
